messages:
maya: starting bring-up for asia-northeast3 GPU pool. hit a blocker: image replication from central-registry to regional mirror hasn't completed, ArgoCD sync stuck on \"ImagePullBackOff\". anyone seen this?

samir: which exact image/tag? cluster-bootstrap or runtime image?

maya: redwood/runtime:cluster-bootstrap-20260316 and redwood/serving:prod-20260314. both missing in the ap mirror.

oliver: checked registry-replication job. pods keep failing with 403 from storage API. likely a service-account permission scope mismatch.

deploy-bot: replication-job/region-mirror-apnortheast status: failed 3/3 pods. last error snippet:
```
AccessDenied: Caller does not have storage.objects.get access to repository \"prod-artifacts-1\"
HTTP 403
```

ria_ops: @maya quick checklist: 1) SA used by replication has roles/storage.objectViewer on the bucket project, 2) IAM binding propagated, 3) firewall allows egress to registry IPs. runbook: https://internal/runbooks/replication (see step 2) :clipboard: 

maya: SA looks like it's in infra-provisioner project but the bucket owner is prod-artifacts-1. SA wasn't granted on that project. i'll request grant and requeue job.

kevin_l: heads up — this region will be A100 multi-zone. cost model is ~+20% to on-demand in us-west. if we plan reserved capacity we should lock it in before scaling.

samir: as a temporary mitigation i can rebuild and push images directly to the regional mirror using my token, then update helm values to point at the mirror host. will do that so Argo can progress while infra fix lands.

oliver: noticed ArgoCD app uses imagePullSecrets: \"reg-creds\" in kube-system. secret wasn't copied to the new cluster during bootstrap. another handoff miss.

maya: adding persistent checklist items for region bring-up: 
- ensure registry SA bindings across projects
- copy imagePullSecrets to kube-system
- replication health check (lag < 5m)
- firewall egress to registries
- confirm GPU driver and CUDA versions on nodes

ria_ops: i'll implement a post-bootstrap validation script that runs all of the above and emits a small status JSON we can attach to the handoff ticket. will also add an argo sync health check.

maya: thanks all — requeued replication job after granting SA access. samir, ping when you push the images so i can start app sync. i'll open a follow-up ticket for the handoff updates. :thumbsup:

samir: pushed redwood/runtime:cluster-bootstrap-20260316 to mirror. updating helm values and kicking argo sync now.

deploy-bot: argo-app/asia-northeast3-cluster sync requested by samir. sync status: in-progress.

oliver: once sync finishes i'll run quick nodes check: `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and `nvidia-smi` on one GPU node to validate driver.

maya: final note for handoff: include cost estimate + capacity plan (on-demand vs reserved) and contact list for registry/team owning prod-artifacts-1.

ria_ops: added validation PR and a small template for the handoff ticket. will tag ops-oncall for signoff.

maya: closing this thread for now, will post final handoff link shortly.
